name: Mini Map
lines: 🗺️ Mini map on. It sits in the compass at the top left; tap it for places by distance.
🧭 Mini map off. The plain compass is back.
✨ Quest trail on. Faint dots on the ground lead toward your next step.
Quest trail off. The story's light and banner still show the way.
🗺️ Mini map and trail Both kept on this device.
A small round map in the compass at the top left, turned the way you face
Faint gold dots on the ground toward your next story step, or the place you asked the way to
The Atlas of All Worlds, and the map of Somnucor
The mini map in the compass, and the quest trail
Where you are in every book you have begun, read from each book's own place this moment.
No book under way. Every world with a story has a 📖 Where to start chip on the left; the 📚 Book Store and the Atlas list them all.
